versions.description: Teleport Requests (/tpa): players ask to teleport to another online player (tpa) or ask someone to come to them (tpahere). The other player gets a private message and answers with tpaccept or tpdeny. Requests expire after a set time, and each player can have one open request (tpcancel withdraws it). Optional cooldown, currency cost (charged only after a successful teleport) and height offset. Players can block others with tpblock. For a warmup, set a delay on the tpaccept command in the module's command settings. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.

commands.name: tpa
commands.description: Ask to teleport to another player
commands.helpText: Asks an online player if you may teleport to them.

commands.name: tpahere
commands.description: Ask another player to teleport to you
commands.helpText: Asks an online player to teleport to you.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: The player to bring to you.

commands.name: tpaccept
commands.helpText: Accepts a teleport request. Without a name it accepts the oldest one.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Name of the player whose request to accept (optional).

commands.name: tpdeny
commands.helpText: Denies a teleport request. Without a name it denies the oldest one.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Name of the player whose request to deny (optional).

commands.name: tpcancel
commands.helpText: Withdraws the teleport request you sent.

commands.name: tpblock
commands.description: Block teleport requests from a player
commands.helpText: Stops a player from sending you teleport requests.

commands.name: tpunblock
commands.helpText: Lets a blocked player send you teleport requests again.

functions.name: tpa

permissions.description: Allows a player to send requests with tpa and tpahere. Answering requests needs no permission.
The player's teleports do not start a cooldown, for example for VIPs.
